data.body: Correction to the change description above: the first full `make verify` failed 1 of 20,360 tests, `test_push_narrow_refspec.py::test_store_modules_never_bare_fetch_the_tickets_branch`. That guard is a line-text scan for the literal `"fetch"` in `_store`, and the first version's `_NETWORK_SUBCOMMANDS = frozenset({"fetch"})` matched it. Revised selection: `sync._git` gives `_LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT` (120 s) to `_INDEX_SUBCOMMANDS = {merge, reset, checkout, status}`, the calls that refresh or rewrite the whole index (status and checkout are the merge-recovery helpers); `fetch` and the cheap reads (rev-parse, merge-base, rev-list, ls-tree) keep `_GIT_TIMEOUT` (30 s). The fetch still goes through `sync._git(t, *args)`, which the CAS-retry tests intercept. Real-git reproductions were rerun against the revision with the same results. Full `make verify` is rerunning.
